description: This file defines a 'Settings' page component using the LightningJS framework. It provides a simple UI with static text and handles navigation input (back, enter). The component appears to be a placeholder for a settings menu in a smart TV weather hub application.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a Settings page with navigation controls.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called when the component is ready.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called when the component gains focus.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Handles the back button press by navigating back in history.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles the enter button press by navigating to the home route ('/').
